patthana16.44:1.1: ajjhattaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bahiddhā na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: bahiddhā hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhatto na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve.
patthana16.44:2.1: ajjhattaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na bahiddhā na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: bahiddhā nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na ajjhatto na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. ajjhattārammaṇattika hetuduke naajjhattārammaṇattika nahetudukaṃ
